why: Greeting on its own line, sign-off split across lines, "Thanks!" as its own paragraph (fill-email-019, fill-message-010).
behaviour: the speaker opens with a greeting ("Hi Hannah, it's me") and closes with thanks and a spoken sign-off ("thanks, yalla, see you", "love you, Dan"), all run into the body
rule: Put the greeting on its own line, the body in short paragraphs, a closing thanks as its own paragraph with an exclamation mark ("Thanks!"), and the sign-off on its own lines ("Love you," then "Dan.").
